calculation.description: Cross-asset medium-horizon momentum scaled by trailing realized volatility. The signal is lagged one completed session to prevent look-ahead. Validation shows a stable negative association with forward returns, so implementations should use direction -1 (equivalent to risk-normalized 20-session reversal).

validation.regime_notes: Validated over 1,984 daily cross-sectional observations from the full synthetic 2020-2034 history, using all 15 tradable benchmark instruments and at least 8 valid instruments per date. Negative IC is economically usable only with explicit reversal direction; uncertainty from the 15-asset cross-section is interpreted conservatively. Recent 750/500/250-date ICs were -0.055969/-0.073386/-0.039713, indicating persistence of the negative association.
